column1: # Catalan (ca) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" forms;
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English labels in standard Catalan,
# using ordinary vector-illustration vocabulary (tauler, traçat, punt d'ancoratge, traç,
# farciment, mostra, degradat, màscara, capa). No other application's Catalan localisation
# resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied, and no other catalog's
# translations were used; add entries the same way.
# Conventions: labels use sentence case; commands use the imperative (Desa, Obre, Mostra).
# Plurals are one/other (singular for 1, plural for 0 and 2+). Status and error messages
# (`@msg`) keep the case of their English first word, as they are often shown after "…: ".
# Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the tests): the product name, OpenType, the
# built-in workspace names and the bracketed perspective grid preset names. Every `ca-*`
# locale (ca-ES, ca-AD, ca-FR, ca-IT, ca-ES-VALENCIA) resolves here. Keep the placeholders
# ({name}), the trailing "…" and the leading/trailing spaces of fragments exactly as they are.
